# Stripe

Payments · options checked 2026-09-20 · [how sources are chosen](../../docs/SOURCING.md)

**Stripe publishes its own tools for AI agents. Start with those.**

The repo ships the same 10 skills under six provider directories; 10 unique. Seven are payments, Connect, billing, tax or paying vendors (stripe-directory). The other three build Stripe apps, provision infrastructure or upgrade SDKs.

## Hosted by the vendor

- **https://mcp.stripe.com** — connect it in Claude as a custom connector (remote MCP server) and sign in with your Stripe account. Stripe's hosted MCP server, named in the stripe/ai README.
  Not on GitHub, so this index cannot watch it for changes.

## What to use

### From Stripe

- **[connect-recommend](../../skills/stripe-connect-recommend/README.md)** — Skill · Only reads; changes nothing · needs company URL or business description · [source](https://github.com/stripe/ai/tree/main/providers/claude/plugin/skills/connect-recommend)
  Use this skill when the user asks about Stripe Connect configuration, charge patterns, Dashboard access, or how to get started with Connect, is building a marketplace, platform, multi-vendor store, gig platform, or subscription platform, needs to pay out sellers, vendors, or providers, mentions split payments, revenue sharing, multi-party payments, or similar payment distribution concepts, provides a company URL or business description for a recommendation, builds SaaS that routes money between parties (for example, POS, booking, invoicing — not operational SaaS without payment routing), asks about onboarding or KYC for merchants, sellers, and vendors, mentions connected account Dashboard or responsibility configurations, or asks about payment flows, white-label payments, or embedded payments.
- **[connect-required-verification-information](../../skills/stripe-connect-verification/README.md)** — Skill · Only reads; changes nothing · needs platformCountry · [source](https://github.com/stripe/ai/tree/main/providers/claude/plugin/skills/connect-required-verification-information)
  Use this skill when the user asks what information a Stripe Connect connected account must provide for verification, onboarding, KYC, or account requirements; when they need to compare requirements between connected-account setups; or when they ask which verification fields, documents, or business details are required for a particular platform country, account country, business type, dashboard, service agreement, or capability.
- **[Metronome billing](../../skills/metronome/README.md)** — Skill · Only reads; changes nothing · needs the integration question · [source](https://github.com/stripe/ai/tree/main/providers/claude/plugin/skills/metronome)
  Usage-based billing through Stripe's official toolkit.
- **[Stripe Pay](../../skills/stripe-pay/README.md)** — Skill · Can move money · needs recipient Stripe Profile handle or network ID · [source](https://github.com/stripe/ai/tree/main/providers/claude/plugin/skills/stripe-pay)
  Stripe's own skill for payment flows.
- **[stripe-best-practices](../../skills/stripe-best-practices/README.md)** — Skill · Only reads; changes nothing · needs integration goal · [source](https://github.com/stripe/ai/tree/main/providers/claude/plugin/skills/stripe-best-practices)
  Stripe's integration guide: Checkout Sessions vs PaymentIntents, Connect, billing and subscriptions, Stripe Tax registrations, Treasury financial accounts, deprecated-API migration and key handling.
- **[stripe-directory](../../skills/stripe-directory/README.md)** — Skill · Can move money · needs provider, merchant or need · [source](https://github.com/stripe/ai/tree/main/providers/claude/plugin/skills/stripe-directory)
  Resolves an external provider, merchant or nonprofit and its documented way to be engaged — pay, donate, subscribe, book or provision — through the Stripe CLI's Directory plugin.
- **[stripe-docs](../../skills/stripe-docs/README.md)** — Skill · Only reads; changes nothing · needs a docs path, search term, or API resource · [source](https://github.com/stripe/ai/tree/main/providers/claude/plugin/skills/stripe-docs)
  Use when the user or agent needs to read, search, or look up Stripe documentation or API reference.
